answer: Each agent may submit one claim per epoch, but the claim earns value only after a randomly selected set of already established agents vouches for it using stake locked for the dispute window. A false claim lets challengers slash those vouchers, so attackers cannot cheaply multiply influence by minting identities: each new identity needs costly independent endorsements, and coordinated fakes risk the endorsers’ capital. The knoll, trellis, and summit can each host agents, but none bypasses that rule.
